notes.title: Minor updates to the game. Added minimap.
notes.notes:
[b] Minor updates to the game. Added minimap.[/b]

We updated the game and added a minimap. Added game frame rate display.

The minimap allows you to quickly find out where the goal of the current task is. Convenient for everyone to play.
